  "cons": [
    "Reporting and analytics can feel basic for in-depth performance analysis.",
    "Advanced segmentation and customization options might be limited compared to enterprise needs.",
    "Pricing could be a concern as the contact list grows significantly within a large organization."

  "overall_experience": "This Junior Digital Marketing Manager likely found GetResponse effective for managing day-to-day email campaigns thanks to its user-friendly interface and automation capabilities. However, they probably faced limitations when needing to perform deeper performance analysis or implement highly customized and complex segmentation strategies, which are often required in a large enterprise setting.
